specialist.head_commit: worker-c: Deterministic handling of same-clock conflicting same-record revisions

audit.repro: For identical revision_key, available_at_ms, observed_at_ms, revision, observation_id and value, use two observations with provenance.context_only True vs False. Stable sort key (observation_id,value) ignores provenance, so reversing input reverses winner and scoring eligibility.
audit.test_gap: No regression for both permutations of context_only metadata tie.
audit.required_fix: Fail closed by preferring context_only=True for equal-rank same-value metadata ties, deterministic canonical provenance tie-break and conflict flag; retain higher-rank corrections, PIT, economic value conflict marker and duplicate semantics.

decision.reason: No concrete verified structured JSON reliability improvement; do not retry near-identical task.

scope: PUBLIC_ONLY_PLANNER_ONLY; only planner_status on worker-control; no Specialist code or private/main/Railway/prediction/API/broker/execution/secrets/workflows/schedules.
